cues: Ligands can be ranked by how strongly they split the d orbitals.
Iodide, bromide, chloride and fluoride are weak: small splitting, high spin.
Then hydroxide, water, ammonia, ethane diamine, nitrite.
Cyanide and carbon monoxide are the strongest: large splitting, low spin.
text: Ligands can be ranked by how strongly they split the d orbitals. This is the spectrochemical series. Iodide, bromide, chloride and fluoride are weak: small splitting, high spin. Then hydroxide, water, ammonia, ethane diamine, nitrite. Cyanide and carbon monoxide are the strongest: large splitting, low spin.
